novel_features.name: Cross-Project Search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across all projects, commits, and deployments in one query
novel_features.rationale: Official CLI searches one entity type per API call. Local FTS5 index enables unified search instantly
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find that project or commit without remembering which entity type contains it

novel_features.name: Since-Style Delta Commands
novel_features.description: See what changed across all projects since a timestamp or last sync
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing current API state against timestamped local snapshots
novel_features.why_it_matters: Resume work with full context after stepping away

novel_features.name: Deployment Drift Detection
novel_features.description: Compare current live deployment against cached configuration to spot unexpected changes
novel_features.rationale: Official CLI only sees current state. Drift detection requires remembering previous state
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch environment variable or build setting changes before they cause production issues

novel_features.name: Stale Deployment Finder
novel_features.description: Find deployments across all projects that haven't been updated in N days
novel_features.rationale: Queries local deployment history table with indexed timestamps
novel_features.why_it_matters: Clean up old deployments to reduce costs and attack surface

novel_features.name: Build Duration Trends
novel_features.description: Track build times over history with averages, p95, and trend indicators
novel_features.rationale: Build durations are ephemeral in the API. We capture and store them on every sync
novel_features.why_it_matters: Identify builds getting slower before they become a bottleneck

novel_features.name: Batch Deploy
novel_features.description: Deploy multiple projects matching a glob pattern with parallelism control
novel_features.rationale: Official CLI deploys one project per invocation. Batch requires local progress tracking
novel_features.why_it_matters: Deploy coordinated changes across microservices in one command

narrative.headline: Every Vibecode feature, plus offline sync, cross-project search, and deployment drift detection no other tool has
narrative.value_prop: A local-first CLI for the vibecode.dev platform that caches your projects, deployments, and commits in SQLite for instant offline access. Adds cross-entity search, since-style delta commands, and deployment drift detection that the official CLI cannot offer.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set VIBECODE_API_KEY from vibecode.dev/key. The CLI validates on first use and caches your user profile locally.

quickstart.comment: Pull all projects, deployments, and commits locally

quickstart.command: vibecode-pp-cli yolo proj_abc --prompt 'Build a todo app'
quickstart.comment: Build and deploy in one shot

troubleshoots.fix: Check VIBECODE_API_KEY is set. Get your key at vibecode.dev/key
Use --project to sync a single project instead of --full
Run 'sync' first or use 'sandboxes acquire' to start one

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you're building apps on vibecode.dev and want offline access to your project data, cross-project search, or deployment drift detection. Ideal for developers managing multiple Vibecode projects or AI agents that need reliable structured output.
